items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Whetsol and Cootie and Ray was in it

ctx.x: I was just going to ask you. Did you --

I don't know whether he was going to put on a fourth trumpet or what, but that was when Whetsol and Cootie and Ray was in it. So I said sure, you know. So he said, "Okay, come on down to rehearsal tomorrow. We're going to have a rehearsal. And come on down and sit in on rehearsal with us." I said okay. So -- we were so crazy in those days. As I said, we were a bit on the young side. And sometimes we didn't get to bed. Sometimes we didn't stop playing till 11:00 o'clock in the morning. That's in the club, and…

my wife that I might go by and rehearse with Duke, and I was tired when I got off. I said, "Oh, I can't make it. I can't make that thing, that rehearsal today." And I was a little leery about it, too. I didn't know if I could make the band or not, you know.
